{{Short description|British biologist (1925–1994)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=September 2019}}
'''Sir Barry Albert Cross''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|size=100%|CBE|FRS|FZS}}<ref name="frs">{{Cite journal | last1 = Heap | first1 = R. B. | last2 = Dyer | first2 = R. G. | doi = 10.1098/rsbm.1998.0007 | title = Sir Barry Albert Cross, C. B. E. 17 March 1925-27 April 1994 | journal = [[Biographical Memoirs of Fellows of the Royal Society]] | volume = 44 | pages = 95–108 | year = 1998 | pmid = 11623992| doi-access = free }}</ref> (17 March 1925 – 27 April 1994) was a British biologist.  He was a fellow of  [[Corpus Christi College, Cambridge]]. He was appointed a Commander of the [[Order of the British Empire]] (CBE) in the [[1981 Birthday Honours]] when he was Director of the [[Institute of Animal Physiology]] at the [[Agricultural Research Council]],<ref>{{London Gazette|issue=48639|page=8|date=12 June 1981|supp=y}}</ref> and knighted in 1989.<ref>‘CROSS, Sir Barry (Albert)’, Who Was Who, A & C Black, 1920–2008; online edn, Oxford University Press, Dec 2007 [http://www.ukwhoswho.com/view/article/oupww/whowaswho/U171917, accessed 21 May 2011]</ref>
